verdict.rationale: Vanta's marketing docs explicitly claim cross-framework control mapping ('cross-map your controls across pre-built frameworks' and 'automate across multiple frameworks without extra effort'), directly supporting the core of this story, and other pages confirm framework-specific automation for SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA. However, no evidence details how overlap is visually surfaced to the user, nor any independent/hands-on confirmation that SOC2 evidence literally auto-populates ISO27001/HIPAA controls. Missing for 10: UI/workflow evidence of overlap visualization, independent verification of automatic reuse across specific frameworks, and technical detail on the mapping mechanism.
